resources.string:
Android only lets apps read the clipboard while they are on screen.

Copy something, then open Clippy or tap Save clipboard now. You can also share text or images to Clippy. Add the quick-settings tile for one-tap save.

Everything you save stays on this phone forever until you delete it.
Background copy capture is blocked on Android 10+. Clippy saves when this screen is open, when you tap Save, when you use the tile, or when you share into the app.
Clipboard is empty or blocked. Open Clippy first, then copy again.
Tap to save whatever is on the clipboard.
